_comment: How much of each field the tree shows. Flipping a flag here changes what appears without touching a component, and nothing is deleted when one is off - the badge components still exist and come straight back.

field._comment: showIdentifier renders the source's own name in monospace beside the label. When nothing curated a label, humaniseIdentifierWhenNoCommonName turns `birthDate` into `Birth date` so the row still reads as English. sentenceCaseLabels lowers curated Title Case to `Date of birth`, matching the collection names above it, and leaves acronyms and type names alone by their shape.

collection._comment: The source's own name beside the collection label, e.g. `Patient` next to `Patient records`.

_labelOverridesComment: Patches identifiers whose humanised form reads badly, keyed by the source's own name. Every key below is data, so the note lives out here rather than inside.
_preserveWordsComment: Words and phrases sentenceCaseLabels must not lower. Acronyms and type names are already safe by their shape; this is for the ones only a person knows - product names, and defined terms a deployment wants kept as written. Empty here on purpose: the words are a deployment's own vocabulary, so they are supplied through the display override rather than shipped by the platform. Matched case-insensitively on whole words, and the spelling written here is the spelling displayed.
